title: CoreWeave picks Bloom fuel cells to power an Illinois AI data center

sources.quote: Announced agreement with CoreWeave, a leader in AI, to power the high-performance data center owned by Chirisa Technology Parks located in Volo, Illinois.

explain: AI cloud provider CoreWeave agreed to use Bloom Energy fuel cells for on-site power at a data center in Volo, Illinois owned by Chirisa Technology Parks. Terms were not disclosed; the date used is when Bloom reported the agreement in its Q2 2024 results, which may be later than the original announcement. Plant: Bloom fuel cells at Chirisa's Volo, Illinois site.
